text.en: As more teams use AI, admins and business leaders need to understand where it creates value and where to invest next. Usage and spend tell part of the story, but admins also need to see what people use AI for and what it helps them accomplish.
text.th: As more teams use AI, admins and business leaders need to understand where it creates value and where to invest next. Usage and spend tell part of the story, but admins also need to see what people use AI for and what it helps them accomplish.

text.en: Analytics in the ChatGPT Admin Console bring together usage and cost data, task insights, and outcome metrics across ChatGPT Work and Codex.
text.th: Analytics in the ChatGPT Admin Console bring together usage and cost data, task insights, and outcome metrics across ChatGPT Work and Codex.

text.en: Here’s how admins can use these tools to understand adoption, support teams, and assess business value.
text.th: Here’s how admins can use these tools to understand adoption, support teams, and assess business value.

text.en: Understand AI usage and spend
text.th: Understand AI usage and spend

text.en: Usage analytics show where adoption is growing and spend is concentrated, helping admins focus support, review costs, and assess capacity requests. The Usage view brings together active users, credits, and token usage across ChatGPT Work and Codex. For example, filtering by group or user can reveal where adoption is low, giving admins a reason to review starting workflows and training needs with the team owner.

text.en: See what work teams are doing with AI
text.th: See what work teams are doing with AI

text.en: The task classifier in Insights helps admins understand what work AI supports by grouping a sample of messages into use cases and tasks. Software engineering, for example, includes feature development and code maintenance, while sales & revenue include account research and planning. The Overview tab shows the mix of work at a glance; the Use cases tab provides a detailed table with task breakdowns. Admins can filter by group to see how teams use AI, then work with business owners to decide which workflows and outcomes to evaluate.

text.en: Identify where teams need training and support
text.th: Identify where teams need training and support

text.en: In task details, the Models, Reasoning, and Speed breakdowns show each setting’s share of credits for a task. This helps admins assess whether the setup fits the work and target training on model selection. A routine brief, for example, may be worth testing with a faster or lower-cost setup, comparing quality and the time spent reviewing and correcting it.

text.en: The Plugin leaderboard and Skills view show which tools support a task, helping admins focus training and decide which workflows to maintain or share. Low use of a relevant plugin may point to an access or training need; a frequently used skill may need a clear owner and regular updates.

text.th: Track Codex contributions to engineering outcomes

text.en: Use the Admin plugin and API to analyze trends and share findings
text.th: Use the Admin plugin and API to analyze trends and share findings

text.en: The Admin plugin in ChatGPT Work lets admins compare adoption, spend, and tasks, then turn findings into reports for budget and rollout decisions. It can also create finished work, such as a leadership deck with charts, key findings, and recommended next steps, ready to share with cross-functional stakeholders.
text.th: The Admin plugin in ChatGPT Work lets admins compare adoption, spend, and tasks, then turn findings into reports for budget and rollout decisions. It can also create finished work, such as a leadership deck with charts, key findings, and recommended next steps, ready to share with cross-functional stakeholders.

text.en: With the Admin API, teams can automate reports in their own dashboards and combine analytics with business-system data. For example, a support dashboard could show credit use alongside ticket resolution time.

text.en: Connect analytics to business outcomes
text.th: Connect analytics to business outcomes

text.en: Usage and task data are a starting point for admins to investigate value with business owners. Business owners add the context needed to assess it: what changed in the workflow, whether results improved, and what that improvement is worth. Together, they can connect product activity to measures such as delivery time, quality, or profitability.
text.th: Usage and task data are a starting point for admins to investigate value with business owners. Business owners add the context needed to assess it: what changed in the workflow, whether results improved, and what that improvement is worth. Together, they can connect product activity to measures such as delivery time, quality, or profitability.

text.en: Suppose the task classifier in the Admin Console shows that account research is common in a sales group. The admin checks whether model choices fit the task, provides training where a CRM plugin is underused, and shares a skill for consistent account plans. The sales owner then compares preparation time and plan quality with the team’s baseline. If time is saved, they track how much goes into customer conversations, which conversations become qualified opportunities, and which opportunities become sales. Revenue and contribution margin on that business help show whether the extra capacity produces a financial benefit.

text.en: Illustrative annual ROI: sales account research
text.th: Illustrative annual ROI: sales account research

text.en: Imagine a team of sellers, each preparing two account briefs per week. Every brief brings together account history, industry research, and a point of view for the next conversation.

text.en: The business impact customers are seeing with AI
text.th: The business impact customers are seeing with AI

text.en: From shipping software to running live events, customers are putting AI to work on tasks that matter to their businesses:
text.th: From shipping software to running live events, customers are putting AI to work on tasks that matter to their businesses:

text.en: 1Password⁠ uses Codex to build, review, and test software so engineers can ship features faster. It estimates 553% ROI and $0.8M in annual engineering capacity value, using Codex to build production-ready features and internal tools faster while maintaining rigorous security policies.

text.en: ATV Big Air Tour⁠ uses ChatGPT Work to check event listings, plan inventory, and improve its website’s visibility. Listing reviews fell from eight hours to one hour a week, and inventory work from two to three days to two to three hours, giving the team more time to focus on the tour and its customers.

text.en: How to get started
text.th: How to get started

text.en: Open Insights in the Admin Console and choose a common task that supports a business priority. Review it with a business owner, agree on a baseline and the outcome to measure, and set a date to review progress. Use the results to decide whether to expand the workflow, improve how teams use it, or test a different approach. Learn more⁠(opens in a new window) in our docs.
